scripts.server:install: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.web:dev: node scripts/generate-placeholder.cjs && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run server:dev" "npm run web:dev"
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-placeholder.cjs && npm --prefix web run build
